class.name: Table
class.brief_description: A table of cells with header roles, row and column spans, frozen rows, and a control footer.
class.description: Each grid position belongs to an anchor cell. Cells have text, an optional icon, a data or header role, alignment, wrapping, and a rectangular span. Header cells use the header theme style; they do not imply frozen rows. Set [member frozen_rows] separately when leading rows should stay visible. All coordinates are zero-based. A span is expressed as (columns, rows). Covered positions are not independently editable: use [method get_cell_owner] to find their anchor before reading or modifying them. Merges are atomic and never discard configured cells. Clear covered cells before merging, or split an existing merged cell first. Spans cannot cross the frozen-row boundary. The standard Inspector exposes [member column_count] and [member row_count], followed by grouped column and cell properties. All data is stored directly on the Table node. Covered positions are hidden until their anchor span is reduced. [codeblock] var table := Table.new() table.set_column_count(2) table.set_row_count(2) table.set_cell(0, 0, "Application") table.set_cell_role(0, 0, Table.HEADER) table.set_cell_span(0, 0, 2, 1) table.set_cell(1, 0, "Version") table.set_cell(1, 1, "4.8") [/codeblock] Add buttons or other controls to the internal [HBoxContainer] returned by [method get_footer]. The footer is always visible and shows the total row count on its left when [member show_row_count] is enabled, including header rows. Optional footer controls occupy the remaining space to the right. The gap theme constant separates the grid from the footer. It stays outside the scrolling grid. Table cells themselves are drawn internally and do not contain arbitrary Control nodes.

method.name: add_row
method.description: Appends an empty row and returns its index.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all rows, clears frozen rows, and resets scrolling. Column configuration and footer controls remain.

method.name: clear_cell
method.description: Resets an anchor cell to empty data with default alignment and wrapping, and splits any span. Use this to explicitly clear cells before merging without silently discarding data.

method.name: get_cell_at_position
method.description: Returns the visible anchor coordinate (column, row) at a table-local position. Returns (-1, -1) outside the grid, in a gap, or while layout is pending.

method.name: get_cell_horizontal_alignment
method.description: Returns alignment of the combined icon and text block: left, center, or right. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_cell_icon
method.description: Returns the optional cell icon. Icons preserve their aspect ratio. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_cell_owner
method.description: Returns the anchor coordinate as (column, row), including when the requested position is covered by another cell.

method.name: get_cell_rect
method.description: Returns the anchor rectangle in table-local coordinates after scrolling and layout. Returns an empty rectangle while layout is pending.

method.name: get_cell_role
method.description: Returns whether the cell is a data cell or header cell. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_cell_span
method.description: Returns the anchor span as (columns, rows).

method.name: get_cell_text
method.description: Returns the cell text. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_cell_vertical_alignment
method.description: Returns vertical alignment of the icon and text block: top, center, or bottom. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_cell_wrap_mode
method.description: Returns whether to inherit, disable, or enable cell wrapping. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: get_column_expand_ratio
method.description: Returns the positive relative share of remaining width for an expanding column.

method.name: get_column_width
method.description: Returns the configured width; for CONTENT and EXPAND this is a minimum.

method.name: get_column_width_mode
method.description: Returns the column sizing mode.

method.name: get_footer
method.description: Returns the internal footer container owned by this Table. Add buttons or other controls to it in code. Do not free or reparent the returned container. Controls align to the end by default.

method.name: insert_column
method.description: Inserts an empty column before [param at], or appends when negative. Spans containing the insertion point expand. Returns the inserted column index.

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts an empty row before [param at], or appends when negative. Spans containing the insertion point expand. Inserting inside the frozen prefix also expands [member frozen_rows]. Returns the inserted row index.

method.name: remove_column
method.description: Removes a column. Intersecting spans shrink; if an anchor is removed, its content moves to the surviving top-left position. The table must retain at least one column.

method.name: remove_row
method.description: Removes a row. Intersecting spans shrink; if an anchor is removed, its content moves to the surviving top-left position. Frozen rows are adjusted to preserve the boundary.

method.name: set_cell
method.description: Sets the anchor cell text and icon together. Omitting the icon removes an existing icon; other cell properties remain unchanged.

method.name: set_cell_horizontal_alignment
method.description: Sets alignment of the combined icon and text block: left, center, or right. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_cell_icon
method.description: Sets the optional cell icon. Icons preserve their aspect ratio. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_cell_role
method.description: Sets whether the cell is a data cell or header cell. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_cell_span
method.description: Changes an anchor cell span. Returns false without modifying data if the span covers configured cells, overlaps another span, or crosses the frozen-row boundary. Spans must be positive and remain within the grid. Setting both spans to one splits the cell; newly exposed positions are empty.

method.name: set_cell_text
method.description: Sets the cell text. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_cell_vertical_alignment
method.description: Sets vertical alignment of the icon and text block: top, center, or bottom. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_cell_wrap_mode
method.description: Sets whether to inherit, disable, or enable cell wrapping. Requires an anchor position.

method.name: set_column_expand_ratio
method.description: Sets the positive relative share of remaining width for an expanding column.

method.name: set_column_width
method.description: Sets the configured width; for CONTENT and EXPAND this is a minimum.

method.name: set_column_width_mode
method.description: Sets the column sizing mode.

members.member: Number of columns. Must be at least one.
Number of rows. Increasing adds empty rows; decreasing removes trailing rows.
Fits the minimum height to every row, including wrapping, spans, and footer controls. Disables internal vertical scrolling. Use when stacking tables in a ScrollContainer.
Number of leading rows kept visible during vertical scrolling. Header roles do not automatically freeze rows. Changes crossing an existing rowspan are rejected.
Shows the total row count on the left of the footer. Disabling it releases the count's horizontal space for footer controls. The footer remains visible.
Default wrapping for cells using INHERIT. Disabled wrapping limits text to one line and uses an ellipsis.

signal.name: cell_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when an anchor cell is left-clicked.

signal.name: cell_layout_changed
signal.description: Emitted when cell geometry or scroll offsets change.

signal.name: table_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a successful grid or table-setting edit. Footer child changes are normal scene-tree changes.

constants.constant: Uses the configured width, including horizontal padding.
Grows to fit content requirements, including constraints from spanning cells.
Uses the configured minimum width and shares extra space according to expand ratio.
A data cell styled with its row panel and optional cell style.
A header cell styled with the header panel and header text color. It can appear anywhere in the grid.
Displays one line, truncating with an ellipsis when necessary.
Wraps text to the resolved span width and grows participating rows to fit.

theme_items.theme_item: Background, outer border, and content margins for the whole table. The default style rounds all four corners.
Optional data-cell style above the row background. Content insets are defined by the cell padding constants.
Always-visible footer panel with rounded bottom corners. Its content margins inset the controls and row count.
Space between rows and columns. Internal gaps are absorbed into merged cells.
Panel for each header cell, covering its entire span. The default style rounds only the top corners.
Left and right padding inside cells, including header cells.
Space between a cell icon and its text.
Maximum icon width; zero disables the limit.
Panel for even body rows. Header-only rows do not advance the alternating-row counter.
Panel for odd body rows. A data rowspan uses its anchor row panel across its full span.
Top and bottom padding inside cells, including header cells.
